svg.text: Rev A · through-hole only · ESP32-C3-Zero on sockets · refs/values match hardware/moskvich_ecu.kicad_pcb
J1.3 chassis, thick wire (4 A pulses)
D1 blocks reverse polarity; D2 clamps load dump (27 V); C1 carries the supply through cranking sag.
U2: 6.5–36 V in, 5 V / 1 A out, SIP-3 drop-in for a 7805 but 90 % efficient. Coil current does NOT flow here.
Fuse the +12V_IN feed (5 A) at the source; F1 is the board-level resettable fuse.
POINTS INPUT (points open ⇒ PT_G / GPIO4 goes LOW)
R1 (above) gives ≈12 mA wetting current through the points. The BC547 inverts, so points open ⇒ PT_C low.
R5 + C5 form a 10 µs filter; the firmware also rejects contact bounce. D3 clamps negative spikes at the base.
ANALOG INPUTS (ADC1 pins GPIO0 / 1 / 3 — ADC2 is unusable with WiFi on)
3.6 V zeners protect the pins from wiring faults. VBAT 12 V → 2.2 V, LPG ≥ 7 V = on / ≤ 4 V = off, MAP 4.8 V → 2.9 V.
MAP sensor: any linear 5 V 1-bar analog type (e.g. GM-style), calibrated with the two-point tool in the web app.
COIL DRIVER — 74HCT123 = on-time guard (≤ 12 ms) + 5 V gate drive
NC pins: 4, 5, 6, 7, 12. Section 2 parked (A high, B/CLR low).
Q1: TO-220 lies flat on the case floor, tab insulated
(pad + shoulder washer), inside the PCB cut-out;
leads bent up through the pads beside the cut-out.
Tab = collector = coil −: up to ~400 V!
Q (13) is high only while CMD is high AND for at most 0.45·27k·1µF ≈ 12 ms, then drops until CMD toggles: a hung MCU cannot cook the coil.
R13 / R16 (10k pull-downs) keep the coil off while the MCU resets or the 5 V rail is missing.
Pad order per the Waveshare list (anticlockwise from the USB connector).
VERIFY against the silkscreen on your module before soldering.
